description: This file defines the CPUCachingAllocator class and related functions for a mobile-specific caching memory allocator in the PyTorch project, including usage patterns, internal data structures, and guard classes.

classes.name: CPUCachingAllocator
classes.description: A caching memory allocator for CPU memory on mobile platforms, supporting allocation, deallocation, and internal caching mechanisms.

classes.name: WithCPUCachingAllocatorGuard
classes.description: A guard class that temporarily sets a specific CPUCachingAllocator for scoped usage.

methods.name: record_free
methods.description: Records a pointer as freed in the cache.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of a given size, using cache if available.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees memory, caching it if appropriate.

methods.name: WithCPUCachingAllocatorGuard
methods.description: Constructor that sets a specific allocator for the scope.
